净值已扣双边交易成本 10.0 bp（换手率 × 费率）；多空/十分层均含停牌股剔除（收益为 NaN 不参与）。
设计意图： This factor combines the primary price impact per unit volatility mechanism (payoff-first) with a lightweight downside/upside return magnitude ratio modifier from a predictive-first parent. The modifier amplifies the impact signal when negative returns have been larger in magnitude than positive returns over a 20-day window, addressing the primary parent's symmetry weakness and targeting improved

因子路由 / 公式 ⚠ FE DSL 暂不支持

factor = ewm_mean(20, |ret|/vol) / EWM_std(ret, 20) * ( -ts_sum(20, neg_ret) / ts_sum(20, pos_ret) )
依赖列: open, high, low, close, volume

算子含义

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
ts_eman 期指数移动平均（EWMA）
ts_ewm_std指数加权移动标准差
ts_pctd 期变化率：(x − x_shift(d)) / x_shift(d)

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 close：close
  2. 计算 volume：volume
  3. 计算 ret：close.pct_change()
  4. 计算 abs_ret：ret.abs()
  5. 计算 impact：abs_ret / volume
  6. 计算 avg_impact：impact.ewm(span=20, min_periods=20).mean()
  7. 计算 vol：ret.ewm(span=20, min_periods=20).std()
  8. 计算 factor：avg_impact / vol
  9. 计算 pos_sum：ret.where(ret > 0, 0).滚动窗口(20, min_periods=10).sum()
  10. 计算 neg_sum：ret.where(ret < 0, 0).滚动窗口(20, min_periods=10).sum()
  11. 计算 ratio：(-neg_sum) / pos_sum
  12. 计算 ratio：ratio
  13. 计算 factor：factor * ratio
  14. 计算 factor：factor

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_price_impact_downside_vol_adjusted(df): df_copy = df.copy() close = df_copy["str">'close'] volume = df_copy["str">'volume'] ret = close.pct_change() abs_ret = ret.abs() impact = abs_ret / volume.replace(0, np.nan) avg_impact = impact.ewm(span=20, min_periods=20).mean() vol = ret.ewm(span=20, min_periods=20).std() factor = avg_impact / vol.replace(0, np.nan) "com"># Lightweight modifier "kw">class="kw">from parent2: downside/upside "kw">class="kw">return magnitude ratio pos_sum = ret.where(ret > 0, 0).rolling(20, min_periods=10).sum() neg_sum = ret.where(ret < 0, 0).rolling(20, min_periods=10).sum() ratio = (-neg_sum) / pos_sum.replace(0, np.nan) ratio = ratio.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(1.0) factor = factor * ratio factor = factor.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0) df_copy["str">'factor_price_impact_downside_vol_adjusted'] = factor "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["str">'factor_price_impact_downside_vol_adjusted']
